Orders

Placing an order is an offer to buy; we confirm it by email. Prices are in Israeli shekels and include VAT for orders within Israel. We may cancel and refund any order we cannot fulfil.

Personalisation

Name and number printing is done to order exactly as you type it. Check spelling before submitting — personalised shirts are only replaced if the print does not match your order or the shirt is faulty.

Delivery

Delivery estimates are 12 to 25 days and are estimates, not guarantees. Customs charges in the destination country are the buyer's responsibility.

Contact

Questions about these terms: use the contact page and we will reply within two business days.
